title: A Letter for the Will
author: Odile Whitlock
blurb: Ines Blackwood, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
